tasks.title: Review sbx-2 openspec plan
tasks.description:
Look through the sbx-2 openspec plan and look for improvements to tighten the plan.
- read the sbx proposal.md documents
- send out subagents to gather relevant context from the dune codebase and the spike reports
- look for aspects where the shape is weakly defined or doesn't have a verification point against the `sbx` binary, where we can improve things for a clearer plan or stronger integration verification point
- avoid shifting product direction - we're burning a few bridges here, this is a breaking change ultimately, but docker sbx will provide a much stronger baseline for our use case
